name: Spy Classroom
description: Spy-in-training Lily is desperate to score a passing grade. Eager to prove herself, she leaps at the chance to join the mysterious team Lamplight and beat the Impossible Mission. Too bad the task ahead is even more harrowing than she imagined…

videos.title: MISSION: Flower Garden I
videos.overview: Spy-school washout Lily just accepted a provisional graduation, and she couldn’t be happier! But there’s more to her new assignment (and her new teacher) than meets the eye.

videos.title: MISSION: Flower Garden II
videos.overview: From defeat comes wisdom. To vanquish Klaus, Team Lamplight must learn from their mistakes — but once they enter enemy territory, the time for mistakes will be over.

videos.title: MISSION: Flower Garden III
videos.overview: Impossible Mission or not, it doesn’t make sense for a team that legendary to go down so easily. A traitor betrays his team.

videos.title: FILE: Fool Erna
videos.overview: Nine elite members form a new team called Lamplight, and they’re going to pick up where Inferno left off.

videos.title: FILE: Lamplight Days
videos.overview: With Wunderkind Lily at its head, Lamplight's going to lead the charge. Their inaugural Impossible Mission is just around the corner.

videos.title: FILE: Pandemonium Sybilla
videos.overview: The girls receive some advice: “Deceive each other. Trick each other. Improve each other.”

videos.title: FILE: Meadow Sara
videos.overview: With a ghost on the loose and a literal ticking time bomb, the girls start worrying about the manor's structural integrity.

videos.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest I
videos.overview: Coming back from a break, everyone is recharged and ready for the next mission. Lamplight's been promoted from a provisional team to an actual team.

videos.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest II
videos.overview: When you’re a spy, sometimes being stealthy is not enough. You also have to be well fed!

videos.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest III
videos.overview: During the Pre-Impossible Mission Planning, the assassins make their way into the manor disguised as delivery people.

videos.title: MISSION: Daughter Dearest IV
videos.overview: Lamplight faces a battle they have to win on their own.

videos.title: FILE: Daughter Dearest Grete
videos.overview: This will be the first time in a long while that all nine Lamplight members back together!

videos.title: MISSION: Forgetter I
videos.overview: Sometimes, you have to give yourself a little reward to make it all worth it.

videos.title: MISSION: Forgetter II
videos.overview: Under rare circumstances, cornered spies will turn to desperate acts of violence. All they can do is pray that others don't get dragged into the situation.

videos.title: MISSION: Forgetter III
videos.overview: The team faces a moral dilemma over Matilda’s fate. She may be an enemy spy, but she is also Annette’s mother.

videos.title: MISSION: Forgetter IV
videos.overview: There’s only one way to get Matilda out of a jam and sneaking her into a cargo freighter leaving the port may be the team’s last hope.

videos.title: FILE: Glint
videos.overview: Everyone is starting to slip up and show signs of psychological strain. Everyone, with one exception.

videos.title: FILE: Dreamspeaker Thea
videos.overview: This will be the first time in a long while that all nine Lamplight members back together!

videos.title: FILE: Forgetter Annette
videos.overview: Annette runs out of spending money buying parts for a machine she is building. The solution? She gets a side job!

videos.title: MISSION: Dreamspeaker I
videos.overview: The latest mission is going to involve infiltrating a foreign country. This will be a major trial for Lamplight.

videos.title: MISSION: Dreamspeaker II
videos.overview: The group questions bringing Roland with them. Unfortunately, he’s the only one who knows what Purple Ant looks like and that makes him valuable.

videos.title: MISSON: Dreamspeaker III
videos.overview: Someone once told Miranda that when she was in the depths of despair, a hero would come to save her. Will that be true in practice?

videos.title: MISSION: Dreamspeaker IV
videos.overview: An intense encounter at a bar. Tears are shed. A gun on the table. What is going on here?

videos.title: FILE: Flower Garden Lily
videos.overview: All roads have led to this as Lamplight shines in this thrilling season finale of Spy Classroom.
